name: services/cards/card
description:
Get information on a given card - specified by exactly one parameter of the following:
	contact_chip_uid, contactless_chip_uid, barcode_number.
brief_description: Get information on a given card.

arguments.name: contact_chip_uid
arguments.description: Unique ID of integrated circuit card

arguments.name: contactless_chip_uid
arguments.description: Unique ID of contacless smart card

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Pipe separated list of requested fields

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

result_fields.name: user
result_fields.description: dictionaries describing the owner of selected card; each dictionary contains fields from primary section in {method_link 'services/users/user'} method,

result_fields.name: contact_chip_uid
result_fields.description: unique ID of integrated circuit card,

result_fields.name: contactless_chip_uid
result_fields.description: unique ID of contacless smart card,

result_fields.name: student_number
result_fields.description: Student number printed on a card
